_doc: Redistribution position per licence key, stamped into catalog.json and dist/LICENSES.md. An asset names its key in meta.json; `qa catalog` copies the block verbatim. `status` is the evidence level, not a wish: 'confirmed' needs written permission or the licence file in sources/licenses/, 'provisional' is our own release position while permission is pending, 'pending' means we have nothing yet. `qa validate` refuses a 'confirmed' claim with no evidence file. `qa dist` marks the npm package private while any bundled asset is not 'confirmed'.

scan.attribution: Traced from a printed mushaf; the ornament design belongs to its publisher. Attribute the mushaf and its archive.org item (both in each asset's `sources`).
scan.note: Derivative works of publisher ornaments (KFGQPC and others). Released non-commercially while written permission is sought — PLAN.md §6, option (b) alongside (a). Not legal advice.

font-ofl.attribution: Outline taken from the U+06DD glyph of an OFL-1.1 font. The licence and the family's copyright notice must travel with the material — both are in dist/LICENSES.md and in each asset's `sources[].license`.
font-ofl.note: SIL Open Font License 1.1, verified from `license: "OFL"` in the family's METADATA.pb in google/fonts; the text is in sources/licenses/. Derivatives stay OFL and cannot be relicensed, and no Reserved Font Name may be used for a modified version — which is why marker ids are numeric and the built font carries no family name.

font-unverified.note: From fonts.quran.ws. Terms are not recorded upstream and have not been confirmed, so no licence is asserted. Designs 014-020. They ship in the repository and in dist/ with that status stated; `status: pending` is what keeps the npm package private, and `qa dist --exclude-unconfirmed` leaves them out.
